purpose: Large film-review library for defining and validating opening setup, separate from the possession outcome analysis.
plannedScope: First-quarter possessions in twelve games covering all twenty-two teams represented in the study export; original A–I examples retained. Include ordinary openings, targeted edge cases, and subsequent possessions.
labelStatus: No new setup classifications are inferred from geometry. User-reviewed labels are retained separately.
validationDesign: Develop the definition with the first eight games; reserve the last four games for testing the frozen rule. Film timing checks do not count as setup classification.
